Collector-Treasurer
Welcome to the Grundy County Collector – Treasurer’s Office.
I am your Collector – Treasurer, Michele Geib.
As Collector – Treasurer, we collect all Real Estate, Personal Property, Surtax, Railroad and Utility taxes, In-Lieu-of Tax, and the Private Car Tax.
Monies are then distributed to the taxing entities.
Non receipt of a tax statement does not waive any of the penalties or interest if it applies.
We will accept payment by check, cash, or money order, and by Visa or MasterCard
Tax statements are mailed on or about November 1st of each year.
Taxes become delinquent after December 31st of each year.
Any “delinquent” personal or real estate taxes owed from previous years must be paid first before the “current” taxes may be paid.
If you do not receive a statement by December 1st, please contact the Assessor’s Office .
